responsibility: Implements the C-family front-end hooks for the rs6000 target. Its responsibilities include parsing machine-specific pragmas such as #pragma longcall, defining and conditionally expanding target preprocessor macros and vector keywords, installing PowerPC/AltiVec builtin types and declarations, and resolving overloaded AltiVec and related intrinsic calls by checking operand types and target availability before selecting the correct backend builtin entry.
